title: Article: Difference between Grihasth and Saint

segments.text: Can a grihasth and a Saint Generate the Same Level of Spiritual Energy?

There is a difference in the energy generated by a Sant (saint) and a Grihasth (householder), but that doesn’t mean a Grihasth cannot generate spiritual energy. In spiritual practice ( sadhana ), following certain rules and disciplines is essential.

For example, if an aspirant who is on a spiritual path, his ability to generate energy depends on how well he follows these disciplines. When observed through the third eye , it is seen that in a male body, virya (vital essence) and in a female body, ojh (subtle energy) play key roles in spiritual progress.

Virya in a male body acts like a fuel that rises through Ida, Pingala, and Sushumna —the three main energy channels—carrying urja shakti (spiritual energy) upward. It functions both as a storage vessel and a means of transporting this energy, much like how electricity flows through a circuit to power a device.
Can Negative Energies Also Form a Soul Contract?
No, a soul contract can only be formed when the one receiving energy is at a higher energy level than the person from whom the energy is being taken. Otherwise, the energy is simply taken forcefully.

For example, if a person encounters a negative entity, and his energy level is lower than that entity’s, the negativity won’t form a soul contract with him. Instead, it will directly drain his energy without any agreement.

On the other hand, higher-level energies always follow the rules of the astral world. That’s why they use a soul contract to receive energy in a structured and lawful way rather than simply taking it.
The Power of Surrender: What Happens When We Offer Our Cosmic Energy to Guru Tatva (Shri Hanumanji Maharaj) in Ashayein?
In Ashaeiynn , when an aspirant continuously energizes the initiated mantra using his pran urja and fully surrenders it to Guru Tatva , an immense amount of energy is generated.

For example, an aspirant dedicated to his practice chants the mantra with deep focus and devotion. As his pran urja fuels the mantra, and surrender its power to Guru Tatva , the energy multiplies, creating a powerful spiritual force that enhances his connection and protection.
